case_name: Smti Jonali Paul v. Smti Mamoni Paul and Ors.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smti Jonali Paul, W/o-Late Himangshu Shekhar Paul
parties.respondent_defendant: Smti Mamoni Paul and 5 Ors., W/o-Late Himangshu Shekhar Paul

facts_of_case: The respondent No. 1 in both the appeals, namely, Smt. Mamoni Paul, had filed a Misc(S/C) Case, u/s 372 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925, which was registered as Misc(S/C) Case No.10/2011, praying for grant

legal_principles.principle: A person who has been mentioned as a legal heir in an application for grant of succession certificate cannot be allowed to deny the fact that they are a legal heir.
legal_principles.held: It is pertinent to mention herein that in her application for grant of Succession Certificate, the petitioner of Misc(S/C) Case No.10/2011, namely Smt. Mamoni Paul, pleaded that her marriage was solemnized with the deceased on 24.02.1999 as per Hindu customs and rituals.

legal_principles.principle: A court may direct a person who has been granted a succession certificate to distribute the shares among other heirs.
legal_principles.held: The Court of the learned District Judge, Dhubri also directed that she has to give the respective shares to the other heirs of the deceased...
